headline: There is no data for 2019: the orders run from Sep 2016 to Oct 2018.

assumptions: Answered from the data's coverage, without a model call

evidence.sql: SELECT dc.month, dc.orders_count AS orders, dc.is_partial, dc.in_analysis_window, COUNT(o.order_id) FILTER(WHERE o.is_delivered) AS delivered_orders, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.items_revenue) FILTER(WHERE o.is_sale), 0), 2) AS revenue FROM data_coverage AS dc LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.purchase_month = dc.month GROUP BY dc.month, dc.orders_count, dc.is_partial, dc.in_analysis_window ORDER BY dc.month LIMIT 501

notes: Questions about Sep 2016 to Oct 2018 can be answered; trends and monthly comparisons use Jan 2017 to Aug 2018, the months with steady volume.
